patches.old_text: Coupons define discounts (percentage or fixed amount) applied to subscriptions. Promotion codes are customer-facing codes that map to coupons. Both can be stacked (up to 20 per subscription/item).
patches.new_text: Coupons define percentage or fixed-amount discounts, and customer-facing promotion codes map to coupons. The 2026-11-07 guide states up to 20 coupon- or code-derived discounts on a subscription, subscription item, **or invoice**; it does not establish one combined budget across those objects. See [[source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons]].
patches.reason: Add invoice scope and preserve the per-target limit boundary.

patches.new_text: - `max_redemptions`: coupon limit across all customers; direct coupon applications and promotion-code redemptions both consume that coupon's counter. `redeem_by`: expiration. See [[source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons]] (2026-11-07 lines 209–215).
patches.reason: Add the explicit shared underlying-coupon redemption counter.

patches.new_text: - Case-insensitive. Distinct customer-restricted active codes may reuse a string; an active code redeemable by any customer cannot share that string with another active code. An inactivated string can be reused. See [[source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons]] (2026-05-13 lines 265–281; 2026-11-07 lines 245–261).
patches.reason: Correct the overbroad uniqueness statement with the customer-restricted exception.

patches.old_text: Apply discounts at both subscription level and subscription item level. Up to 20 per `discounts[]`.
patches.new_text: Apply discounts at subscription and subscription-item levels. The 2026-11-07 guide also states a limit of up to 20 on an invoice; coupon- and promotion-code-derived discounts share each stated target limit. The 2026-05-13 stacking section says up to 20 entries per `discounts` parameter. See [[source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons]].
patches.reason: Add invoice scope without asserting a global combined cap.

patches.old_text: - Updating discounts alone doesn't trigger prorations — only when combined with proration-triggering changes (quantity change, price change, etc.)
patches.new_text: - Updating discounts alone creates neither prorations nor an invoice. A separate billable current-cycle change, such as a quantity or price change, can trigger proration; if combined in the same call, the proration uses the updated discount state. See [[source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons]] (2026-05-13 lines 583–587; 2026-11-07 lines 499–503).
patches.reason: Make the causal boundary explicit so discount updates are not read as a proration trigger.

scope: Merge approved source-specific edits only; preserve unrelated content and source qualifications. No canonical writes.
